text: Runbook: PACS DICOM TLS handshake failures. Required response: rotate the expired gateway certificate after an approved change. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：PACS DICOM TLS 握手失败。处置要求：审批变更后轮换已过期的网关证书。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for LIS interface queue backlog.

Runbook: LIS interface queue backlog. Required response: scale the consumer and replay the dead-letter queue after validation. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：LIS 接口队列积压。处置要求：扩容消费者并在验证后重放死信队列。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for HIS database connection pool exhaustion.

Runbook: HIS database connection pool exhaustion. Required response: identify leaked sessions before raising the pool limit. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：HIS 数据库连接池耗尽。处置要求：提高连接池上限前先定位泄漏会话。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for EMR search index lag.

Runbook: EMR search index lag. Required response: resume the failed shard and rebuild only the stale index partition. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：EMR 检索索引延迟。处置要求：恢复失败分片并仅重建过期索引分区。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for RIS modality worklist mismatch.

Runbook: RIS modality worklist mismatch. Required response: verify AE Title mapping and scheduled station name. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：RIS 检查设备工作列表不匹配。处置要求：核对 AE Title 映射和 Scheduled Station Name。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for archive storage capacity alert.

Runbook: archive storage capacity alert. Required response: extend the mounted volume then verify filesystem growth. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：归档存储容量告警。处置要求：扩展已挂载卷并确认文件系统完成扩容。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for HL7 acknowledgement timeout.

Runbook: HL7 acknowledgement timeout. Required response: inspect receiver latency and retry only messages without an ACK. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：HL7 应答超时。处置要求：检查接收端延迟并只重试未收到 ACK 的消息。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for SSO token rejected because of clock skew.

Runbook: SSO token rejected because of clock skew. Required response: restore NTP synchronization before refreshing signing keys. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：SSO 因时钟偏差拒绝令牌。处置要求：先恢复 NTP 同步再刷新签名密钥。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for backup restore verification failure.

Runbook: backup restore verification failure. Required response: quarantine the damaged backup set and run a clean-room restore. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：备份恢复验证失败。处置要求：隔离损坏备份集并执行洁净环境恢复。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for clinical portal DNS failover delay.

Runbook: clinical portal DNS failover delay. Required response: lower TTL before the change window and verify both resolvers. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：临床门户 DNS 故障切换延迟。处置要求：变更窗口前降低 TTL 并验证两台解析器。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for partner API rate limit saturation.

Runbook: partner API rate limit saturation. Required response: apply bounded exponential backoff and a tenant-specific queue. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：合作方 API 限流饱和。处置要求：应用有界指数退避和租户独立队列。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for session Redis memory pressure.

Runbook: session Redis memory pressure. Required response: inspect eviction policy and remove orphaned synthetic sessions. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：会话 Redis 内存压力。处置要求：检查淘汰策略并清理孤立的模拟会话。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for integration Kafka rebalance storm.

Runbook: integration Kafka rebalance storm. Required response: stabilize consumer membership before changing partition count. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：集成 Kafka 频繁重平衡。处置要求：调整分区数前先稳定消费者成员关系。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for remote support VPN packet fragmentation.

Runbook: remote support VPN packet fragmentation. Required response: discover path MTU and clamp TCP MSS at the authorized gateway. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：远程支持 VPN 数据包分片。处置要求：探测路径 MTU 并在授权网关限制 TCP MSS。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for device gateway NTP drift.

Runbook: device gateway NTP drift. Required response: restore the approved time source and confirm monotonic timestamps. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：设备网关 NTP 漂移。处置要求：恢复批准的时间源并确认时间戳单调。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for service account LDAP lockout.

Runbook: service account LDAP lockout. Required response: find stale credentials in scheduled jobs before unlocking the account. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：服务账号 LDAP 锁定。处置要求：解锁前先定位计划任务中的旧凭据。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for object storage intermittent 503 errors.

Runbook: object storage intermittent 503 errors. Required response: check quorum health and rebalance only after capacity is stable. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：对象存储间歇性 503。处置要求：检查仲裁健康并仅在容量稳定后重平衡。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for reverse proxy incomplete certificate chain.

Runbook: reverse proxy incomplete certificate chain. Required response: install the missing intermediate certificate without replacing the private key. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：反向代理证书链不完整。处置要求：补充缺失的中间证书且不替换私钥。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for billing batch misses its processing window.

Runbook: billing batch misses its processing window. Required response: isolate the slow stage and resume from the last committed checkpoint. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：结算批处理错过时间窗口。处置要求：隔离慢阶段并从最后提交的检查点恢复。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for monitoring label cardinality explosion.

Runbook: monitoring label cardinality explosion. Required response: drop the unbounded request identifier label at ingestion. Verification must be recorded. 运维主题：监控标签基数爆炸。处置要求：在采集端删除无限增长的请求标识标签。必须记录验证结果。 Distractor boundary: this runbook does not authorize the response for PACS DICOM TLS handshake failures.
